description: Source code implementing cryptographic signing and hashing functionalities, including classes for different hash types, HMAC support, and external C interface functions for creating, destroying, ingesting data, and calculating signatures.

classes.name: SigningType
classes.description: Template class implementing signing functionality for different hash types, supporting data ingestion and digest calculation.

methods.name: signing_create_hash
methods.description: Creates a hash signing implementation based on specified hash type.

methods.name: signing_create_hmac
methods.description: Creates an HMAC signing implementation with a secret identified by secret_id.

methods.name: signing_ingest
methods.description: Feeds data into the signing implementation.

methods.name: signing_calculate
methods.description: Calculates and retrieves the digest or signature.
